mutations.name: Null Capability Guard Removal
mutations.unmutatedBehavior: Throws SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: Invalid or missing SealingCapability.
mutations.mutatedBehavior: Allows unauthenticated callers to acquire authoritative HMAC seal tokens.

mutations.name: Capability Object Identity Weakening
mutations.unmutatedBehavior: Throws SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: Unrecognized or forged SealingCapability.
mutations.mutatedBehavior: Allows structurally forged JSON objects matching the SealingCapability interface to pass.

mutations.name: Authority State Handshake Check Removal
mutations.unmutatedBehavior: Throws SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_NOT_INITIALIZED: Cannot seal domain binding before secure authority handshake completion.
mutations.mutatedBehavior: Permits pre-boot execution and sealing without cryptographic authority boot.

mutations.name: Domain Scope Enforcement Removal
mutations.unmutatedBehavior: Throws SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: Capability is not authorized for domain <domain>.
mutations.mutatedBehavior: Enables cross-domain privilege escalation (e.g. thermal capability sealing CAD structures).

mutations.name: Revocation Registry Bypass
mutations.unmutatedBehavior: Throws SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: Unrecognized or forged SealingCapability on subsequent calls.
mutations.mutatedBehavior: Enables token replay attacks across session and test boundaries.

conclusion: All 5 runtime authority gates exhibit strict Fail-Closed behavior when unmutated, successfully mitigating runtime risks that evade static regex detection.
